name: paper-to-latex-diagram-generator
description: Generate publication-grade academic diagrams from paper text or reference images as LaTeX/TikZ or draw.io, with compile verification and iterative visual review.

profession.zh: 学术论文配图设计专家

displayDescription.en: Turn paper excerpts or reference screenshots into publication-grade academic diagrams. Outputs editable LaTeX/TikZ code or draw.io XML, embeds data visualizations into architecture figures, then compiles, renders and visually reviews every iteration until layout, color and information density meet journal standards.
displayDescription.zh: 把论文文案或截图转化为发表级学术配图，自动编译验证并多轮视觉审查，直到排版与配色全面达标。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Generate a publication-grade system architecture diagram from a paper excerpt in LaTeX/TikZ.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 根据论文段落生成一张发表级系统架构图，输出 LaTeX/TikZ 代码。

quickPrompts.en: Generate a publication-grade system architecture diagram from a paper excerpt in LaTeX/TikZ.
quickPrompts.zh: 根据论文段落生成一张发表级系统架构图，输出 LaTeX/TikZ 代码。

quickPrompts.en: Recreate this reference figure as an editable TikZ vector diagram.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这张参考图复刻成可编辑的 TikZ 矢量图。

quickPrompts.en: Draw a thesis technical roadmap in draw.io format.
quickPrompts.zh: 用 draw.io 画一张毕业论文技术路线图。
